content.rendered:
If you need to register your child for the 2020-2021 school  year, you can find the  registration forms here, or you can find them located on the District website under the Information tab, then Enrollment Process page.    


 If you would like a registration packet mailed to you, please email Michelle Wunnicke at mwunnicke@sherwood.k12.or.us with your address and contact information.      


You are welcome to mail your completed packet to:

Middleton Elementary
23505 SW Old Hwy 99W
Sherwood, OR 97140     
If you should have any other questions you are welcome to email them as well.   Wishing you all the best and stay well.
